# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
```

# Missingness proportion among SNPs
```{r}
# Load table
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
Missingness_Prop <- read.delim("Missingness_Prop.txt", header=F, sep=" ")
colnames(Missingness_Prop) <- c("POS", "Missingness_Proportion")

# Set your window size in base pairs
window_size <- 50000


# Create a window index for each row
Missingness_Prop_binned <- Missingness_Prop |>
  mutate(window = floor(POS / window_size) * window_size) |>
  group_by(window) |>
  summarize(mean_missingness = mean(Missingness_Proportion))

# Plot: one point per window for mean missingness
ggplot(Missingness_Prop_binned, aes(x = window + window_size/2, y = mean_missingness)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position",
    y = "Mean Missingness per Window",
    title = paste("Missingness Across Genome - USA (", window_size, "bp windows)", sep="")
  )
```

# Gaps proportion among SNPs

```{r}
# Load table
Missingness_Prop_NL <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_NL/Missingness_Prop.txt", header=F, sep=" ")
colnames(Missingness_Prop_NL) <- c("POS", "Missingness_Proportion_NL")

Missingness_Prop_NL_CDC <- left_join(Missingness_Prop, Missingness_Prop_NL)

# Calculate correlation (Pearson's r and p-value)
cor_res <- cor.test(Missingness_Prop_NL_CDC$Missingness_Proportion, 
                    Missingness_Prop_NL_CDC$Missingness_Proportion_NL)

r_val <- round(cor_res$estimate, 3)
p_val <- signif(cor_res$p.value, 2)

# Create plot
Missingness_Prop_NL_CDC |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = Missingness_Proportion, y = Missingness_Proportion_NL)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "USA Missingness Proportion",
    y = "Netherlands Missingness Proportion",
    title = "Missingness Across Genome - Netherlands vs USA"
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0, y = 0.9, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
           label = paste0("r = ", r_val, "\n", "p = ", p_val),
           size = 5)

# Set your window size in base pairs
window_size <- 50000


# Create a window index for each row
Missingness_Prop_NL_binned <- Missingness_Prop_NL |>
  mutate(window = floor(POS / window_size) * window_size) |>
  group_by(window) |>
  summarize(mean_missingness = mean(Missingness_Proportion_NL))

# Plot: one point per window for mean missingness
ggplot(Missingness_Prop_NL_binned, aes(x = window + window_size/2, y = mean_missingness)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position",
    y = "Mean Missingness per Window",
    title = paste("Missingness Across Genome - Netherlands (", window_size, "bp windows)", sep="")
  )
```
